scope: Nine primary documentation and research references reread during E01 execution; not closure of E05 or the source/test census
retrieval: web search, direct official-page open and targeted section lookup
license_review: Citations and original paraphrases only; per-file code/fixture licenses and revision pins remain required by E05 before copying

entries.source_version: rolling documentation, no imported revision pin
entries.observed_technique: Separate browser API assertion tests, rendering reference tests, visual checks and crash tests.
entries.uos_adaptation_inference: Classify each transferred OCaml/Gleam test by its actual oracle and whether a browser executes it; use reference pages for specified layout invariants and process/crash evidence for malformed input cases.
entries.tradeoff: WPT's own runner includes Python; UOS can study patterns and run admitted browser fixtures through its bounded OCaml controller without introducing Python outside MAX.

entries.source_version: rolling documentation; runtime version must be pinned separately
entries.observed_technique: Action traces associate before/action/after DOM snapshots with screenshots, console failures, network requests and browser/viewport metadata.
entries.uos_adaptation_inference: Attach the same action identity to intent, DOM/AST, accessibility, image and network evidence in each of the four page/component cycles; inspect causal differences rather than counting screenshots.
entries.tradeoff: Trace storage and capture overhead need budgets; redact unrelated authenticated/session data and retain explicit missing-artifact states.

entries.source_version: rolling wiki page; exact page revision and fixture commit required before adoption
sections_read: Running selser with a specific edit
entries.observed_technique: Parser tests cover wikitext/HTML conversion in both directions and round trips; selective serialization tests apply generated DOM edits and compare results.
entries.uos_adaptation_inference: Generate constrained wiki AST edits and test parse/render/serialize semantic round trips, link identity and preservation of untouched fragments. Use the original OCaml oracle without modifying its code.
entries.tradeoff: Declare the UOS dialect and semantic equivalence relation; MediaWiki-specific templates or canonicalization are not automatically UOS requirements.

entries.observed_technique: Assess user experience measurements at the 75th percentile, separately across mobile and desktop, using all three Core Web Vitals.
entries.uos_adaptation_inference: Keep lab timing and real user field measurements in separate datasets with sample counts and device cohorts. Four automated cycles alone do not establish field percentiles.
entries.tradeoff: A private Tailnet site may lack sufficient field observations; report insufficient data instead of inventing quality scores.

entries.primary_authority: Google Research; Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu
entries.source_version: CHI 2010 publication landing page; abstract reread, full paper not reread in this support task
entries.observed_technique: HEART links product goals to user-centered metrics and decision making.
entries.uos_adaptation_inference: Define measurable success for locating a note, following a cited source, recovering a failed action and completing a wiki edit; connect task outcomes with later UX/CX feedback.
entries.tradeoff: Behavioral proxies and automated test outcomes cannot substitute for observed user attitudes; no survey or external message was sent.

entries.primary_authority: W3C RDF Data Shapes Working Group
entries.source_version: SHACL Recommendation; selected overview and core constraints read
entries.observed_technique: A shapes graph expresses path, type, cardinality and closed-property constraints over a data graph, producing validation results.
entries.uos_adaptation_inference: Give wiki pages, notes, references and test receipts typed graph constraints: required origin, bounded relation multiplicity, valid inverse links and no undeclared evidence fields. Map each violated shape to a named Gleam property failure.
entries.tradeoff: A Gleam shape subset is not full SHACL conformance; declare unsupported clauses and test against pinned official manifests before making that claim.

entries.source_version: PROV-DM Recommendation; selected model sections read
entries.observed_technique: Separate entities, producing activities, responsible agents, derivations and bundles describing provenance itself.
entries.uos_adaptation_inference: Track code/docs as immutable entities, actual invocations as activities, and reviewers as attributed agents; represent claimed ratification separately from its verification activity and input evidence.
entries.tradeoff: A provenance graph records assertions; it does not authenticate a signer or prove the associated execution by itself.

entries.observed_technique: A document-wide link checker records broken links and redirects and accounts for rate-limited servers.
entries.uos_adaptation_inference: Build a bounded link graph crawl with distinct missing, redirected, forbidden, timed-out and rate-limited outcomes, plus source file/anchor locators for repair.
entries.tradeoff: External availability is unstable; preserve retry receipts and explicit exceptions. Port the technique through Gleam/Hermes instead of adopting Sphinx's Python runtime.

entries.observed_technique: Production builds can reject broken links; anchor handling has a distinct configurable policy.
entries.uos_adaptation_inference: Run AST-derived route and fragment resolution at build time and repeat real rendered navigation checks at runtime; make mandatory internal anchor failures blocking.
entries.tradeoff: Static link validation cannot prove hydrated controls, history behavior, scroll position or final visual appearance.
